# `Q-3-36` — Unprocessed EditComment Markup

> EditComment editorial markup `[>> ...]` was not desugared to
> a Span during postprocessing.

## What this means

Quarto's CriticMarkup-inspired comment construct `[>> ...]` is
parsed as an `EditComment` AST node — an editorial aside from
one collaborator to another, not intended for the final reader.
Postprocessing rewrites it as a `Span` with the `.quarto-edit-comment`
class before the writer runs. This error fires when a raw
`EditComment` node reaches the writer.

This is a defensive guard. The condition is a pipeline bug, not
a source-level mistake.

## Why this happens

Two known triggers:

- **A Lua filter ran after postprocessing** and reintroduced an
  `EditComment` AST node.
- **A bug in the postprocessor** that misses some comments.

## How to fix

If a custom filter is in use, ensure it does not produce
`EditComment` AST nodes after postprocessing. If no filter is
in use, report the document at the Quarto issue tracker.

## Related

- `Q-3-33`, `Q-3-34`, `Q-3-35` — same condition for `Insert`,
  `Delete`, and `Highlight` markup respectively.
